Players Committee card image of [[Savareen Standoff]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If a battle was just initiated, immediately fire a blaster deployed on your smuggler present. That blaster may fire again this battle. OR Your smuggler armed with a weapon card is defense value +2 for remainder of turn (even if just targeted by an Interrupt or weapon).” Uploaded unchanged.
